📝 Walkthrough
This pull request adds a graph-free `TripleDataset` carrier and extends Datalog, SRL inference, SPARQL evaluation, and text indexing to support triple-shaped data. It also adds named-graph capability checks, tests, benchmarks, documentation, and WASM test selections. **Changes: Graph-free triple carrier** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Triple storage, builder, and conversion**
`crates/rdf-core/src/ir/builder/triple.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/triple.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/dataset.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/frozen_terms.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/builder.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/validate.rs`, `crates/lex/src/allocation.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/benches/ir_layout.rs`|Adds compact triple, reifier, and annotation storage with lazy ordinal permutations. Moves frozen term data into `FrozenTerms` and adds conversion from `RdfDataset` when named graphs are absent.| |**Read sessions and public API**
`crates/rdf-core/src/ir/triple/read.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/dataset_view.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/mod.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/lib.rs`, `crates/rdf/src/lib.rs`|Adds fallible triple read sessions, graphless view operations, typed named-graph refusals, and public carrier exports.| **Arity-aware Datalog execution** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Clause and store shapes**
`crates/datalog/src/clause.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/store.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/dictionary.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/guard.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/admission.rs`|Generalizes clauses, stores, guards, and admission APIs over arity. Triple stores use three positions and predicate-only partition keys.| |**Planning, cache, and proofs**
`crates/datalog/src/plan.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/cache.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/proof.rs`|Carries arity through plans, cache entries, and proof APIs. Triple clause hashes and proof encodings use separate domains.| |**Evaluation and scheduling**
`crates/datalog/src/seminaive.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/seminaive/evidence.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/seminaive/factors.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/chase.rs`, `crates/datalog/src/schedule.rs`|Generalizes joins, derivations, chase, evidence, and schedules to shaped facts. Base reads require scheduled evaluation, which can retain a base snapshot.| |**Runtime checks and identity domains**
`crates/datalog/tests/rules_runtime.rs`, `crates/datalog/README.md`, `crates/hash/README.md`|Adds runtime coverage for triple evaluation, snapshots, no-output rules, and store behavior. Documents triple and quad shapes and lists triple-specific hash domains.| **SRL triple inference** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Carrier-specific rule lowering**
`crates/shapes/src/srl/lower.rs`|Selects triple or quad rule shapes during lowering. Triple rules represent base reads as metadata and use `NoOutput` for legal empty heads.| |**Inference and publication**
`crates/shapes/src/srl/document.rs`, `crates/shapes/src/srl/eval.rs`, `crates/shapes/src/rules.rs`, `crates/shapes/src/term.rs`, `crates/shapes/src/srl/mod.rs`, `crates/shapes/tests/*`, `crates/purrdf/tests/base_surface.rs`|Adds `infer_triples` and evaluates triple reads through the arity-three engine. Inferred rows are published to the matching carrier. Tests compare triple and quad inference.| **SPARQL triple-carrier support** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Named-graph checks and query behavior**
`crates/sparql-eval/src/dataset_spec.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/src/eval.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/host_identity.rs`|Checks named-graph support before graph-dependent query evaluation. Tests cover graph-request refusals and compare default-graph results across carriers.| |**Retained-result conformance**
`crates/sparql-conformance/src/compare.rs`, `crates/sparql-conformance/src/lib.rs`, `crates/sparql-conformance/src/run.rs`, `crates/sparql-conformance/tests/triple_carrier.rs`|Adds retained evaluation outcomes and shared verdict accounting. The triple-carrier test runs supported cases from the SPARQL 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 corpora and records named-graph refusals.| **Graph-free text profiles** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Corpus profiles and index shapes**
`crates/text/src/corpus.rs`, `crates/text/src/index.rs`, `crates/text/src/lib.rs`|Adds `GraphFree` alongside the default `GraphLanguage` profile. Graph-free indexes use language-only partitions and separate identity domains.| |**Profile-aware retrieval and tests**
`crates/text/src/dictionary.rs`, `crates/text/src/dictionary_relation.rs`, `crates/text/src/occurrence_dictionary.rs`, `crates/text/src/relation.rs`, `crates/text/src/score.rs`, `crates/text/tests/*`|Propagates corpus profiles through matching, relations, and scoring. Tests cover graph-free indexing, retrieval, RDF 1.2 partitions, and named-graph refusals.| **Shared validation and tooling** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Audit, macros, and SIMD assembly tools**
`crates/helper-census/src/*`, `crates/lex/src/constructors.rs`, `helpers-ledger.toml`, `scripts/*`, `docs/design/purrdf-simd.md`|Extends helper-census authority checks to frozen term ownership. Extends `variant_from!` for const-generic targets. SIMD assembly tooling adds consumer-bench support and local runtime contexts.| |**Test selection and documentation**
`Makefile`, `docs/WASM_TESTING.md`, `docs/book/*`, `docs/design/purrdf-backend-contract.md`, `crates/*/README.md`|Adds WASM test selections and documents triple storage, reads, inference, and graph-free text indexing.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~60 minutes
